name: imicroseq_wastewater
description: Schema for describing waste water metadata

fields.name: specimen_collector_sample_id

meta.comments: Store the collector sample ID. If this number is considered identifiable information, provide an alternative ID. Be sure to store the key that maps between the original and alternative IDs for traceability and follow up if necessary. Every collector sample ID from a single submitter must be unique. It can have any format, but we suggest that you make it concise, unique and consistent within your lab.

external_mapping.GISAID: Sample ID given by the sample provider

fields.description: The user-defined name for the sample.

fields.name: sampling_site_id

meta.comments: Store the ID for the site from which a sample was taken. The "site" is user defined (e.g. it may be a building and its environs, a specific entity within an environment). Please use the same site ID for all samples from a given site, regardless of when these samples were taken. Any important changes in site location, should be represented with a new site ID.

fields.description: The user-defined identifier assigned to a specific location from which samples are taken.

fields.name: sampling_event_id

meta.comments: Store the ID for the event during which a sample or samples were taken. For example, an event could be one person taking samples from multiple sites, or multiple people taking samples from one site.

fields.description: The user-defined identifier assigned to a specific event during which one or more samples are taken, from one or more sites.

fields.name: insdc_project_accession

meta.comments: Store the BioProject accession number. BioProjects are an organizing tool that links together raw sequence data, assemblies, and their associated metadata. Each province will be assigned a different bioproject accession number by the National Microbiology Lab. A valid NCBI BioProject accession has prefix PRJN e.g., PRJNA12345, and is created once at the beginning of a new sequencing project.

fields.description: The INSDC (i.e., ENA, NCBI, or DDBJ) accession number of the Project(s) to which the Sample belongs.

fields.name: insdc_sample_accession

meta.comments: Store the accession returned from the Sample submission. NCBI BioSamples will have the prefix SAMN, ENA have the prefix SAMEA, DDBJ have SAMD

fields.description: The identifier assigned to a Sample in INSDC (i.e., ENA, NCBI, or DDBJ) archives.

fields.name: insdc_sequence_read_accession

meta.comments: Store the accession assigned to the submitted sequence. European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) sequence accessions start with ERR, NCBI-SRA accessions start with SRR,  DNA Data Bank of Japan (DDBJ) accessions start with DRR and Genome Sequence Archive (GSA) accessions start with CRR.

fields.description: The identifier assigned to a sequence in one of the International Nucleotide Sequence Database Collaboration (INSDC) repositories.

fields.name: sample_collection_project_name

meta.comments: Provide the name of the project and/or the project ID here. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

fields.description: The name of the project/initiative/program for which the sample was collected.

fields.name: organism

meta.comments: Provide the official nomenclature for the organism(s) present in the sample. Multiple organisms can be entered, separated by semicolons. Avoid abbreviations. Search for taxonomic names here: ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy.

fields.description: Taxonomic name of the organism.

fields.name: purpose_of_sampling

meta.comments: The reason a sample was collected may provide information about potential biases in sampling strategy. Provide the purpose of sampling from the picklist in the template. Most likely, the sample was collected for Public health surveillance. The reason why a sample was originally collected may differ from the reason why it was selected for sequencing, which should be indicated in the "purpose of sequencing" field.

fields.description: The reason that the sample was collected.

fields.name: sample_collected_by_organisation_name

meta.comments: The name of the agency should be written out in full, (with minor exceptions) and be consistent across multiple submissions.

fields.description: The name of the organization with which the sample collector is affiliated.

fields.name: sample_collected_by_contact_email

meta.comments: The email address can represent a specific individual or lab e.g. johnnyblogs@lab.ca, or RespLab@lab.ca

fields.description: The email address of the contact responsible for follow-up regarding the sample.

fields.name: sample_collection_data_steward_name

meta.comments: Provide the name of the sample collection data steward.

fields.description: The name of the individual responsible for the data governance, (meta)data usage and distribution of the sample.

fields.name: sample_collection_start_date

meta.comments: Sample collection date is critical for surveillance and many types of analyses. For samples taken at a single point in time, use this field to capture the date the sample was collected. If your sample was collected continuously over an interval, use this field to capture the sample collection start date. Required granularity includes year, month and day. The date should be provided in ISO 8601 standard format "YYYY-MM-DD".

fields.description: The date on which the sample was collected, or sampling began for a continuous sample.

fields.name: sample_collection_end_date

meta.comments: Provide the date that sample collection ended in ISO 8601 format i.e. YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.description: The date on which sample collection ended for a continuous sample.

fields.name: sample_collection_time_duration_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of time.

fields.description: The amount of time over which the sample was collected.

fields.name: sample_collection_time_duration_unit

meta.comments: Provide the units from the pick list.

fields.description: The units of the time duration measurement of sample collection.

fields.name: geo_loc_name_country

meta.comments: If known, select a value from the pick list.

fields.description: The country of origin of the sample.

codeList: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands [GAZ:00003990]

fields.name: geo_loc_name_state_province_territory

meta.comments: Provide the state/province/territory name from the GAZ geography ontology. Search for geography terms here: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/ga

fields.description: The state/province/territory of origin of the sample.

fields.name: geo_loc_name_site

meta.comments: Provide the name of the specific geographical site using a specific noun (a word that names a certain place, thing).

fields.description: The name of a specific geographical location e.g. Credit River (rather than river).

fields.name: geo_loc_latitude

meta.comments: Provide latitude coordinates if available. Do not use the centre of the city/region/province/state/country or the location of your agency as a proxy, as this implicates a real location and is misleading. Specify as degrees latitude in format "d[d.dddd] N|S".

fields.description: The latitude coordinates of the geographical location of sample collection.

fields.name: geo_loc_longitude

meta.comments: Provide longitude coordinates if available. Do not use the centre of the city/region/province/state/country or the location of your agency as a proxy, as this implicates a real location and is misleading. Specify as degrees longitude in format "d[dd.dddd] W|E".

fields.description: The longitude coordinates of the geographical location of sample collection.

fields.name: environmental_site

meta.comments: Provide a descriptor of the environmental site sampled. Use the picklist provided in the template. If not applicable, choose a null value.

fields.description: An environmental location may describe a site in the natural or built environment e.g. hospital, wet market, lake.

fields.name: proximal_environmental_site

meta.comments: Provide a descriptor of the environmental site close to the sampling site. Use the picklist provided in the template. If not applicable, choose a null value.

fields.description: An environmental location in the natural or built environment, that is proximal to a sampling location and which can impact a sample.

fields.name: presampling_activity_id

meta.comments: Store the ID for the relevant event prior to sample collection, which impacts the sample or sample collection process. For example, a flood event occuring in 2025 is the reason for these samples being collected.

fields.description: The user-defined identifier assigned to a specific event that occured prior to sample collection.

fields.name: presampling_activity_date

meta.comments: Provide the date of the presampling event. If this date was over a range provide the start date.

fields.description: The date of the presampling event.

fields.name: presampling_activity

meta.comments: If there was an activity that would affect the sample prior to collection (this is different than sample processing), provide the activities by selecting one or more values from the template pick list. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

fields.description: The activities or variables prior to sample collection that may affect the sample.

fields.name: presampling_activity_details

meta.comments: Briefly describe the presampling activities using free text.
examples: Agricultural waste from large farm contributes waste to the site sampled.

fields.description: The details of the activities or variables that affected the sample collected.

fields.name: collection_device

meta.comments: Provide a descriptor of the device used for sampling. Use the picklist provided in the template. If not applicable, choose a null value.

fields.description: The instrument or container used to collect the sample e.g. grab sampler.

fields.name: collection_method

meta.comments: Provide a descriptor of the collection method used for sampling. Use the picklist provided in the template. If not applicable, choose a null value.

fields.description: The process used to collect the sample.

fields.name: environmental_material

meta.comments: Provide a descriptor of the environmental material sampled. Use the picklist provided in the template. If not applicable, choose a null value.

fields.description: A substance obtained from the natural or man-made environment e.g. soil, water, sewage.

fields.name: environmental_material_properties

meta.comments: Provide the environmental material properties by selecting descriptors from the pick list.

fields.description: The properties, characteristics and qualities of a substance obtained from the natural or man-made environment.

fields.name: anatomical_material

meta.comments: An anatomical material is a substance taken from the body. If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the anatomical material from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

fields.description: A substance obtained from an anatomical part of an organism e.g. tissue, blood.

fields.name: anatomical_part

meta.comments: An anatomical part is a structure or location in the body. If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the anatomical material from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

fields.description: An anatomical part of an organism e.g. oropharynx.

fields.name: body_product

meta.comments: A body product is a substance produced by the body but meant to be excreted/secreted (i.e. not part of the body). If applicable, select the standardized term and ontology ID for the body product from the picklist provided. Multiple values can be provided, separated by a semi-colon.

fields.description: A substance excreted/secreted from an organism e.g. feces, urine, sweat.

fields.name: taxonomic_identification_process

meta.comments: Provide the type of method used to determine the taxonomic identity of the organism by selecting a value from the pick list. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

fields.description: The type of planned process by which an organismal entity is associated with a taxon or taxa.

fields.name: read_mapping_software_name

meta.comments: Provide the name of the read mapping software.

fields.description: The name of the software used to map sequence reads to a reference genome or set of reference genes.

fields.name: read_mapping_software_version

meta.comments: Provide the version number of the read mapping software.

fields.description: The version of the software used to map sequence reads to a reference genome or set of reference genes.

fields.name: taxonomic_reference_database_name

meta.comments: Provide the name of the taxonomic reference database.

fields.description: The name of the taxonomic reference database used to identify the organism.

fields.name: taxonomic_reference_database_version

meta.comments: Provide the version number of the taxonomic reference database.

fields.description: The version of the taxonomic reference database used to identify the organism.

fields.name: experimental_specimen_role_type

meta.comments: Samples can play different types of roles in experiments. A sample under study in one experiment may act as a control or be a replicate of another sample in another experiment. This field is used to distinguish samples under study from controls, replicates, etc.  If the sample acted as an experimental control or a replicate, select a role type from the picklist. If the sample was not a control, leave blank or select "Not Applicable".

fields.description: The type of role that the sample represents in the experiment.

fields.name: specimen_processing

meta.comments: Select processes from the picklist that were applied to this sample.

fields.description: Any processing applied to the sample during or after receiving the sample.

fields.name: specimen_processing_details

meta.comments: Briefly describe the processes applied to the sample.
examples: 5 samples were pooled and further prepared as a single sample during library prep.

fields.description: The details of the processing applied to the sample during or after receiving the sample.

fields.name: experimental_protocol_name

meta.comments: Provide the name of the methodology used in your study.

fields.description: The name of the overarching experimental methodology that was used to process the biomaterial.

fields.name: experimental_protocol_url

meta.comments: Provide the url of the experimental protocol.

fields.description: A URL linking to detailed information or documentation about the experimental protocol. This URL should direct users to a source that provides the necessary details to reproduce the experiment that generated the dataset.

fields.name: experimental_control_details

meta.comments: Provide details regarding the nature of the reference strain used as a control, or what is was used to monitor.
examples: Human coronavirus 229E (HCoV-229E) spiked in sample as process control.

fields.description: The details regarding the experimental control contained in the sample.

fields.name: nucleic_acid_extraction_method

meta.comments: Briefly describe the extraction method used.
examples: Direct wastewater RNA capture and purification via the "Sewage, Salt, Silica and SARS-CoV-2 (4S)" method v4 found at https://www.protocols.io/view/v-4-direct-wastewater-rna-capture-and-purification-36wgq581ygk5/v4

fields.description: The process used to extract genomic material from a sample.

fields.name: endogenous_control_details

meta.comments: Provide the names of endogenous controls that were used as a reference during extraction. If relevant, include titers of these controls, as well as whether any controls were expected but not identified in the sample.

fields.description: The description of the endogenous controls included when extracting a sample.

fields.name: available_data_types

meta.comments: This field provides information about additional data types that are available that may provide context for interpretation of the sequence data. Provide a term from the picklist for additional data types that are available. Additional data types may require special permission to access. Contact the data provider for more information.

fields.description: The type of data that is available, that may or may not require permission to access.

fields.name: available_data_type_details

meta.comments: Use this field to provide free text details describing other available data types that may provide context for interpreting genomic sequence data.
examples: Pooled metagenomes containing extended spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL) bacteria

fields.description: Detailed information regarding other available data types.

fields.name: populated_area_type

meta.comments: Provide the populated area type from the pick list.

fields.description: A type of area that is populated by humans to different degrees.

fields.name: water_catchment_area_human_population_measurement_value

meta.comments: Where known, provide the numerical value of population size, i.e. the number of people.

external_mapping.ENA_SEWAGE_ERC00036: population size of the catchment area

fields.displayName: water catchment area human population measurement value
fields.description: The numerical value of the human population measurement that contributes to the composition of water in a catchment area.

fields.name: water_catchment_area_human_population_range

meta.comments: Where catchment population is not well known, provide an estimation of population size by selecting a value from the picklist.

fields.displayName: water catchment area human population range
fields.description: The human population range of the water catchment that contributes effluent to a wastewater site.

fields.name: presampling_weather_conditions

meta.comments: Provide the weather conditions prior to sample collection by selecting a value from the picklist.

fields.description: Weather conditions prior to collection that may affect the sample.

fields.name: sampling_weather_conditions

meta.comments: Provide the weather conditions at the time of sample collection  by selecting a value from the picklist.

fields.description: The state of the atmosphere at a place and time as regards heat, dryness, sunshine, wind, rain, etc.

fields.name: water_depth_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical depth only  of water only (without units).

fields.description: The depth of some water from which the sample was collected.

fields.name: water_depth_units

meta.comments: Provide the units of measurement for which the depth was recorded  by selecting a value from the picklist.

fields.description: The units of measurement for water depth.

fields.name: sediment_depth_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical depth only of the sediment (without units).

fields.description: The depth of some sediment from which the sample was collected.

fields.name: sediment_depth_units

meta.comments: Provide the units of measurement for which the depth was recorded by selecting a value from the picklist.

fields.description: The units of measurement for sediment depth.

fields.name: ph_measurement_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of the measured pH.

fields.description: The measured pH value indicating the acidity or basicity(alkalinity) of an aqueous solution.

fields.name: total_daily_flow_rate_measurement_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of the measured flow rate.

fields.displayName: total daily flow rate measurement value
fields.description: The numerical value of a measured fluid flow rate over the course of a day.

fields.name: total_daily_flow_rate_measurement_unit

meta.comments: Provide the units of the measured flow rate by selecting a value from the pick list.

fields.displayName: total daily flow rate measurement unit
fields.description: The units of a measured fluid flow rate over the course of a day.

fields.name: instantaneous_flow_rate_measurement_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of the measured flow rate.

fields.description: The numerical value of a measured instantaneous fluid flow rate.

fields.name: instantaneous_flow_rate_measurement_unit

meta.comments: Provide the units of the measured flow rate by selecting a value from the pick list.

fields.description: The units of a measured instantaneous fluid flow rate.

fields.name: turbidity_measurement_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of the measured turbidity.

fields.description: The numerical value of a measurement of turbidity.

fields.name: turbidity_measurement_unit

meta.comments: Provide the units of the measured turbidity by selecting a value from the pick list.

fields.description: The units of a measurement of turbidity.

fields.name: conductivity_measurement_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of the measured conductivity.

fields.description: The numerical value of a measurement of conductivity.

fields.name: conductivity_measurement_unit

meta.comments: Provide the units of the measured conductivity by selecting a value from the pick list.

fields.description: The units of a measurement of conductivity.

fields.name: salinity_measurement_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of the measured salinity.

fields.description: The numerical value of a measurement of salinity.

fields.name: salinity_measurement_unit

meta.comments: Provide the units of the measured salinity by selecting a value from the pick list.

fields.description: The units of a measurement of salinity.

fields.name: dissolved_oxygen_measurement_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of the measured dissolved oxygen.

fields.description: The numerical value of a measurement of dissolved oxygen.

fields.name: dissolved_oxygen_measurement_unit

meta.comments: Provide the units of the measured dissolved oxygen by selecting a value from the pick list.

fields.description: The units of a measurement of dissolved oxygen.

fields.name: total_suspended_solids_tss_measurement_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of the measured TSS.

fields.description: The numerical value of total suspended solids of a sample.

fields.name: total_suspended_solids_tss_measurement_unit

meta.comments: Provide the units of the measured TSS by selecting a value from the pick list.

fields.description: The units associated with a value from a total suspended solids (TSS) test.

fields.name: fecal_contamination_indicator

meta.comments: If a fecal contamination indicator was measured, select it from the picklist.

fields.description: A gene, virus, bacteria, or substance used to measure the sanitary quality of water in regards to fecal contamination.

fields.name: fecal_contamination_value

meta.comments: Provide the numerical value of the measured fecal contamination.

fields.description: The numerical value of a measurement of fecal contamination.

fields.name: fecal_contamination_unit

meta.comments: Provide the units of the measured fecal contamination  by selecting a value from the picklist.

fields.description: The units of a measurement of fecal contamination.

codeList: log10 gene copies per 100 milliliter (log10 GC/100 mL)
log10 gene copies per nanogram total DNA (log10 GC/ ng)

fields.name: host_common_name

meta.comments: If the sample is directly from a host, either a common or scientific name must be provided (although both can be included) by selecting a value from the picklist. If known, provide the common name.

fields.description: The commonly used name of the host.

fields.name: host_scientific_name

meta.comments: If the sample is directly from a host, either a common or scientific name must be provided (although both can be included), by selecting a value from the picklist. If known, select the scientific name from the picklist provided.

fields.description: The taxonomic, or scientific name of the host.

fields.name: host_age_bin

meta.comments: Select the corresponding host age bin from the pick list provided in the template. If not available, provide a null value or leave blank. NOTE: Age bins for animals may differ from those used for humans.

fields.description: Age of host at the time of sampling, expressed as an age group.

fields.name: host_age

meta.comments: If known, provide the age of the host. Age-binning is also acceptable.

fields.description: Age of host at the time of sampling.

fields.name: host_age_unit

meta.comments: If known, provide the age units used to measure the host's age from the pick list.

external_mapping.NCBI_SRAGenomeTrakr: host age (combine value and units with regex; IF year [UO:0000036] THEN years, IF month [UO:0000035] THEN months)

fields.description: The units used to measure the host's age.

fields.name: isolate_id

meta.comments: Provide the isolate_ID created by the lab that first isolated the isolate (i.e. the original isolate ID). If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value. If only an alternate isolate ID is known (e.g. the ID from your lab, if your lab did not isolate the isolate from the original sample), make asure to include it in the alternative_isolate_ID field.

fields.description: The user-defined identifier for the isolate, as provided by the laboratory that originally isolated the isolate.

fields.name: microbiological_method

meta.comments: Provide the name and version number of the microbiological method. The ID of the method is also acceptable if the ID can be linked to the laboratory that created the procedure.

fields.description: The laboratory method used to grow, prepare, and/or isolate the microbial isolate.

fields.name: strain_id

meta.comments: If the isolate represents or is derived from, a lab reference strain or strain from a type culture collection, provide the strain identifier.

fields.description: The strain identifier.

fields.name: isolated_by_organisation_name

meta.comments: Provide the name of the agency, organization or institution that isolated the original isolate in full (avoid abbreviations). If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

fields.description: The name of the agency, organization or institution with which the individual who performed the isolation procedure is affiliated.

fields.name: purpose_of_sequencing

meta.comments: The reason why a sample was originally collected may differ from the reason why it was selected for sequencing. The reason a sample was sequenced may provide information about potential biases in sequencing strategy. Provide the purpose of sequencing from the picklist in the template. The reason for sample collection should be indicated in the "purpose of sampling" field.

fields.description: The reason that the sample was sequenced.

fields.name: assay_type

meta.comments: Provide the name of the sequencing technology used in your study, or alternatively PCR assay, by selecting a value from the picklist. If unsure refer to the protocol documentation, or provide a null value.

fields.description: The experimental process that was used in to quantify, amplify or identify the sequence of a biomaterial.

fields.name: sequencing_date

meta.comments: ISO 8601 standard "YYYY-MM-DD".

fields.description: The date the sample was sequenced.

fields.name: sequenced_by_organisation_name

meta.comments: Provide the name of the agency, organization or institution that performed the sequencing in full (avoid abbreviations). If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

fields.description: The name of the agency, organization or institution responsible for sequencing the isolate's genome.

fields.name: sequenced_by_contact_email

meta.comments: Provide the email associated with the listed contact. As personnel turnover may render an individual's email obsolete, it is more prefereable to provide an address for a position or lab, to ensure accuracy of information and institutional memory. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

fields.description: The email address of the contact responsible for follow-up regarding the sequence.

fields.name: sequencing_protocol

meta.comments: Provide the name and version of the procedure or protocol used for sequencing. You can also provide a link to a protocol online.

fields.description: The protocol or method used for sequencing.

fields.name: sequencing_instrument

meta.comments: Provide the model sequencing instrument by selecting a value from the template pick list. If the information is unknown or cannot be provided, leave blank or provide a null value.

fields.description: The model of the sequencing instrument used.

fields.name: library_preparation_kit

meta.comments: Provide the name of the library preparation kit used.

fields.description: The name of the DNA library preparation kit used to generate the library being sequenced.

fields.name: genomic_target_enrichment_method

meta.comments: Provide the name of the enrichment method by selecting a value from the picklist.

fields.description: The molecular technique used to selectively capture and amplify specific regions of interest from a genome.

fields.name: genomic_target_enrichment_method_details

meta.comments: Provide details that are applicable to the method you used.
examples: Enrichment was performed using Illumina Target Enrichment methodology using the Illumina DNA Prep with Enrichment kit.

fields.description: Details that provide additional context to the molecular technique used to selectively capture and amplify specific regions of interest from a genome.

fields.name: amplicon_pcr_primer_scheme_name

meta.comments: Provide the name and version of the primer scheme used to generate the amplicons for sequencing.

fields.description: The specification name of the primers (primer sequences, binding positions, fragment size generated etc) used to generate the amplicons to be sequenced.

fields.name: amplicon_pcr_primer_scheme_url

meta.comments: Provide the url of the primer scheme used to generate the amplicons for sequencing.

fields.description: A URL linking to detailed information or documentation about the amplicon PCR primer scheme, including specifications such as primer sequences, binding positions, and fragment sizes. This URL should direct users to a source that provides the necessary details to reproduce or understand the primer scheme used in the dataset.

fields.name: raw_sequence_data_processing_method

meta.comments: Provide the software name followed by the version or a link to the github protocol e.g. Trimmomatic v. 0.38, Porechop v. 0.2.3

fields.description: The method used for raw data processing such as removing barcodes, adapter trimming, filtering etc.

fields.name: dehosting_method

meta.comments: Provide the name and version number of the software used to remove host reads.

fields.description: The method used to remove host reads from the pathogen sequence.

fields.name: genome_sequence_file_name

meta.comments: Provide the name and version number, with the file extension, of the processed genome sequence file e.g. a consensus sequence FASTA file or a genome assembly file.

fields.description: The name of the consensus sequence file.

fields.name: sequence_assembly_software_name

meta.comments: Provide the name of the software used to assemble the sequence.
examples: SPAdes Genome Assembler, Canu, wtdbg2, velvet

fields.description: The name of the software used to assemble a sequence.

fields.name: sequence_assembly_software_version

meta.comments: Provide the version of the software used to assemble the sequence.

fields.description: The version of the software used to assemble a sequence.

fields.name: consensus_sequence_software_name

meta.comments: Provide the name of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.

fields.description: The name of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.

fields.name: consensus_sequence_software_version

meta.comments: Provide the version of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.

fields.description: The version of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.

fields.name: breadth_of_coverage_value

meta.comments: Provide value as a percent.

fields.description: The percentage of the reference genome covered by the sequenced data, to a prescribed depth.

fields.name: depth_of_coverage_value

meta.comments: Provide value as a fold of coverage.

fields.description: The average number of reads representing a given nucleotide in the reconstructed sequence.

fields.name: genome_completeness

meta.comments: Provide the genome completeness as a percent (no need to include units).

fields.description: The percentage of expected genes identified in the genome being sequenced. Missing genes indicate missing genomic regions (incompleteness) in the data.

fields.name: reference_genome_accession

meta.comments: Provide the accession number of the reference genome.

fields.description: A persistent, unique identifier of a genome database entry.

fields.name: bioinformatics_protocol_url

meta.comments: Further details regarding the methods used to process raw data, and/or generate assemblies, and/or generate consensus sequences can. This information can be provided in an SOP or protocol or pipeline/workflow. Provide the name and version number of the protocol, or a GitHub link to a pipeline or workflow.

fields.description: A description of the overall bioinformatics strategy used.

fields.name: quality_control_method_name

meta.comments: Providing the name of the method used for quality control is very important for interpreting the rest of the QC information. Method names can be provided as the name of a pipeline or a link to a GitHub repository. Multiple methods should be listed and separated by a semi-colon. Do not include QC tags in other fields if no method name is provided.

fields.description: The name of the method used to assess whether a sequence passed a predetermined quality control threshold.

fields.name: quality_control_method_version

meta.comments: Methods updates can make big differences to their outputs. Provide the version of the method used for quality control. The version can be expressed using whatever convention the developer implements (e.g. date, semantic versioning). If multiple methods were used, record the version numbers in the same order as the method names. Separate the version numbers using a semi-colon.

fields.description: The version number of the method used to assess whether a sequence passed a predetermined quality control threshold.

fields.name: quality_control_determination
